scope: Frontend plain-language verification, photo upload, shared request errors and authentication validation.
changes: Verification file errors remain beside their picker and are announced to assistive technology. The photo picker is keyboard accessible.
SVG, PDF, other unsupported formats, empty files, large photos and device read errors include a next step. Existing usable photos remain selected when a replacement is rejected.
Submission failures keep selected photos available for retry. Both thrown API errors and unsuccessful response bodies use readable messages.
Shared error handling translates common connection, permission, timeout, image and schema details while preserving specific business messages and actual upload limits.
Profile photo processing, email and mobile validation, request/listing creation, sign-in, registration and password recovery use simpler wording. Registered-email recovery remains intact.

verification.tests: 109 passed across 9 files, including verification upload, shared API errors, image validation, authentication, request/listing actions and password settings.
verification.eslint: Passed for all TypeScript files changed in this request.
verification.typeScript: Passed the production TypeScript check; an earlier standalone no-emit check also passed.
verification.build: Final production build passed with 109 generated pages. Temporary preview route absent.
verification.detector: No findings in the verification, photo selection and validation surfaces.

browserChecks: Real VerificationUpload component rendered in a temporary local public preview with an API adapter that returns illustrative responses and never submits real documents.
Selecting a sample SVG shows the replacement instruction immediately on desktop and a 390px browser viewport.
At phone width the document client width and scroll width both measure 380px; error text wraps without horizontal overflow.
Opening the photo picker with Enter and selecting an illustrative PNG clears the format error.
A simulated server rejection displays a readable message while keeping the selected photo and enabling retry.
Browser viewport restored, functional preview closed, temporary route and sample files removed, and the agent-started dev server stopped before the production build.
limitations: Browser captures use illustrative local data and the Help Center shell in light mode. Component tests cover both themes. No real identity documents were uploaded. The failed initial preview tab could not be bound for manual closure because the browser URL policy blocks its generated data URL; it remains an unmarked temporary tab. Backend files, permissions and validation were not modified by this request. No commit or push was made.
